svg.title: Device Visualization — top navigation alternative
svg.desc: Static design proposal with illustrative data. A single top navigation bar frees 216 pixels for module content. Infrastructure, Diagnostics and Utilities menus provide module navigation. Not a working application.
svg.text: Document physical ports, destinations and VLAN assignments.
TOP NAVIGATION ALTERNATIVE · ILLUSTRATIVE DATA · 216 PX MORE CONTENT WIDTH · NOT A LIVE SYSTEM
